q: The entanglement of purification E_p(ρ_{AB}) is defined as the minimum entanglement of a purification |ψ⟩_{ABB'A'} of ρ_{AB}: E_p(ρ) = min_{|ψ⟩ purification} S(AA'). It satisfies:
opts: E_p(ρ) ≤ min(S(A), S(B)) and E_p(ρ) ≥ I(A:B)/2
exp: Entanglement of purification satisfies E_p(ρ) ≥ S(A)/2 and E_p ≥ I(A:B)/2. For pure states, E_p = S(A). For separable states, E_p ≥ 0 but may be positive (unlike entanglement measures). E_p appears in the AdS/CFT holographic dictionary as the minimal entanglement wedge cross-section.
